questions.question: Explain two religious teachings about the treatment of animals.

points.text: 1) Christianity teaches dominion — humans have authority over animals (Genesis 1:28) but this means responsible care, not exploitation. The RSPCA was founded by Christians and St Francis of Assisi taught that animals are our brothers in creation. 2) Islam teaches that animals must be treated with respect as part of Allah's creation.
